problem_statement: Operators need a verifiable heartbeat endpoint for uptime checks.
user_outcome: An operator can verify the service is alive with one unauthenticated call.

user_stories.so_that: I can verify the service is alive

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given the service is running, when GET /health is called, then the response status is 200 and the body reports status "ok".

north_star_metric: Percentage of monitored services whose outages are detected before a user reports them.
